problem.bodyTop: Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot. Every one of them runs on your laptop. Close the lid and the session ends. A dropped connection erases hours of work. Switch projects and the agent forgets where it was.
problem.bodyMiddle: Ellul gives your agent a workstation of <emphasis>its own</emphasis>. Persistent, isolated, always on. It runs through the night, and you wake to a finished feature, a reviewed PR, a drafted doc.
problem.bodyBottom: The agent still answers to you. Approve a merge between meetings. Check progress from the subway. Nothing about shipping overnight requires you at a desk.

howItWorks.headline: A workstation in the cloud. One click away.
howItWorks.subhead: Sign up, spin up, and let the agent run. Three steps to an always-on workstation that ships while you sleep.

signup.title: Sign up with a passkey
signup.desc: FIDO2 from the start. Your fingerprint or hardware key is the only thing that ever approves a privileged action. No passwords, nothing to leak.

spinup.title: Spin up a workstation
spinup.desc: Click Create. You get a persistent Linux machine in EU with your agent already running, your repo already cloned, your dev server already alive.

handoff.title: Hand it the work and walk away
handoff.desc: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode. Pick your driver. Close the tab. Come back to a finished branch, a drafted PR, a tap-to-approve.

alwaysOn.title: Always on
alwaysOn.desc: Your agent doesn’t stop when your laptop does. Long refactors, overnight test loops, week-long migrations all keep running.

parallel.title: Multiple agents in parallel
parallel.desc: One per role. Each gets its own sandbox. They peer read-only and never break each other.

offLaptop.title: Off your laptop
offLaptop.desc: Your SSH keys, AWS creds, and 1Password CLI never leave your machine. Credentials live in your vault and never touch the agent.

persistent.title: Persistent state
persistent.desc: Encrypted storage that survives restarts, hibernation, and wake. The agent picks up where it left off, every time.

realDev.title: Real dev environment
realDev.desc: Bash, git, Node, Bun, Python, Postgres, Caddy. Custom domains. Live preview URL. The same machine your agent codes against, you can SSH into.

stack.title: Plugged into your stack
stack.desc: GitHub, Vercel, Fly, Neon, Supabase. Production credentials get brokered at approval time. The agent never sees the key.

gates.headline: Yes means yes.
gates.bodyTop: All this autonomy is only possible because every privileged action pauses for your passkey. Git push, prod DB, domain changes. They stop, wait for a biometric tap, and only then happen.
gates.bodyBottom: That’s how you let an agent run for 8 hours unsupervised without getting burned.

agentWorkstation.a: An agent workstation is a persistent, isolated computer that exists for an AI agent to work on. It is always on. It has its own filesystem, processes, and network. Privileged actions are gated at the boundary so they require a human passkey approval. The agent runs there, not on your laptop.

vsCursor.q: How is Ellul different from Cursor or Claude Code?
vsCursor.a: Cursor and Claude Code are agents. Ellul is the computer the agent runs on. You can keep using your existing agent. Ellul moves it off your laptop onto a workstation that never closes, supports multiple agents in parallel, and gates every privileged action behind a passkey.

parallel.q: Can I run multiple AI agents in parallel?
parallel.a: Yes. Each agent gets its own workstation. They run independently. Read-only peering lets one agent see another’s source code without being able to edit it, push it, or escalate it.

passkey.q: How does passkey gating work in practice?
passkey.a: Privileged actions (git push, deploy, database writes, secret access) pause mid-execution. You receive a notification. You tap your passkey to approve or decline. The agent only proceeds if you approve. Credentials never reach the agent process.

duration.q: How long can an agent run unattended?
duration.a: Indefinitely. The workstation stays online whether you are at your laptop or not. Customer agents have run uninterrupted for multiple days through long refactors and migration scripts.
